Tracking card (whole card): faded, reduced opacity (about 55%), so its contents look lighter.
Tracking card background: white to a faint off-white (#fbfafd-ish).
Tracking card border: lighter lavender.
"EXPECTED" label: dark brown to mid grey-brown.
"Thursday, before noon": dark brown to mid grey-brown.
"IN TRANSIT" badge: deep purple to light purple, text still white.
Progress bar fill: deep purple to light purple, same width.
Progress bar track: lavender to a lighter lavender.
Timeline dots: tan to a paler beige.
Timeline labels ("Collected in Bristol", "Sorted at the Midlands hub", "Out for delivery"): dark to grey.
Timeline times ("Mon 09:14", "Tue 22:40", "Not yet"): purple-grey to a lighter grey-purple.
